name: io.github.wism-corp/scrupp
description: Export LinkedIn, Sales Navigator and Apollo searches, find decision makers at a company, and find and verify work email addresses

environmentVariables.name: SCRUPP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Scrupp API key, from Settings → API Keys at app.scrupp.com

environmentVariables.name: SCRUPP_WAIT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long a tool waits for a job before handing back its id instead. Default 120.
